subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, holding a microphone
initial_pose: standing turned three-quarters to the right, leaning slightly forward, left hand holding the microphone at chest height, right arm extended down to the right with the open palm facing up, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like a friendly salesman explaining a payment plan: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, the head nods a little with each point; the hand holding the microphone moves it slightly toward the mouth and back; the free right hand rises to chest height and counts on its fingers, raising one finger, then two, then three, in rhythm with the words; then settles back into the starting pose
